circuit.skyabyss.title: Circuit
circuit.skyabyss.task.hunt_go: Go to %s and defeat the foes
circuit.skyabyss.task.guard_go: Go to %s and guard the pillar
circuit.skyabyss.task.carry_pick: Pick the dropped load back up
message.skyabyss.circuit.no_town: Circuits start from the guide of a regional town.
message.skyabyss.circuit.busy: You are already on a circuit. To quit: /skyabyss_circuit leave
message.skyabyss.circuit.offer.head: ── Circuit (%s) ──
message.skyabyss.circuit.offer.body: For 20 minutes, small tasks appear around this region one after another (defeat, guard, carry). Each one earns a circuit mark; at the end you get coins and sealed boxes by your marks. Party members nearby walk with you.
message.skyabyss.circuit.offer.left: Rewards today: %s left (%s a day, resets at 5 AM)
message.skyabyss.circuit.offer.hover: Click to start a circuit (20 minutes)
message.skyabyss.circuit.failed: Too late for that task. On to the next
message.skyabyss.circuit.carry_drop: The load was dropped. Pick it up again
message.skyabyss.circuit.reward_titan: 6 or more marks: a titan's sealed box too
message.skyabyss.circuit.no_reward_daily: You already took today's circuit rewards (%s). Marks still count toward regional fame
entity.skyabyss.world_event.name: Great %s
message.skyabyss.world_event.begin: World event: %2$s has come to %1$s. Head for the red pillar (it leaves in 15 minutes)
message.skyabyss.world_event.appear: %s appears! Take it on with everyone nearby
message.skyabyss.world_event.down: %s was calmed (your share %s%%). %s coins, %s sealed boxes
map.skyabyss.world_event.here: A great foe for everyone nearby. Leaves after 15 minutes
message.skyabyss.fame.gift: A gift from the townsfolk: %s coins and a sealed box
message.skyabyss.fame.discount: Shops in the %s town now give %s%% off
message.skyabyss.journal.head: ── Fame and travel journal ──
message.skyabyss.journal.foot: Fame rises with circuits, world events, named foes, board errands and new sights. Sights enter the journal when you come near. Codex: /skyabyss_codex
message.skyabyss.journal.done: Travel journal: you found every sight of %s
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_town_guide_whale: See fame and the travel journal
See fame and the travel journal
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_town_guide_storm: See fame and the travel journal
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_town_guide_ember: See fame and the travel journal
message.skyabyss.guild_week.flag: Your guild holds the flag of %s this week. The weekly goods are in the storage
message.skyabyss.guild_week.honor: Last week's tower rank %s: %s tower shards in the guild storage
message.skyabyss.codex.head: ── Codex ──
message.skyabyss.codex.foot: Gear enters the codex when you get it, foes when you defeat them. Complete sets pay coins and titles
message.skyabyss.codex.set_done: Codex: you collected all %s gear (%s coins)
message.skyabyss.codex.all_done: Codex: you collected every titan's gear
message.skyabyss.codex.foes_done: Codex: you defeated every foe of the continent (%s coins)
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_smith.menu.l: Change a weapon's look (to a codex weapon)
message.skyabyss.look.no_weapon: Hold the weapon to restyle in your main hand and talk again.
message.skyabyss.look.head: ── Look of %s ──
message.skyabyss.look.none: No weapon of the same kind is in your codex yet. You can wear the shape of weapons you got from titans and raids.
message.skyabyss.look.hover: Click to take this shape (%s coins)
message.skyabyss.look.foot: Only the shape changes (power, skills and moves stay). %s coins each, going back is free
message.skyabyss.look.cleared: %s is back to its own shape
message.skyabyss.circuit.left_today: Circuit rewards left today: %s (%s a day)
message.skyabyss.circuit.none_today: Today's rewards (%2$s) are already taken. Marks still count toward fame
dialogue.skyabyss.guest_town_guide_whale:
For 20 minutes, small tasks pop up at this land's sights one after another: defeat foes, guard a pillar, carry a load.
Each one earns a circuit mark; at the end you get coins and sealed boxes by your marks. Rewards 3 times a day. Party members nearby walk with you.

gui.skyabyss.journey.title: Journey
gui.skyabyss.journey.tip.no_flag: This week's flag: no guild holds it yet
gui.skyabyss.journey.tip.how: Fame rises with circuits, world events, named foes, board errands and new sights
gui.skyabyss.journey.tip.mastery: Experience past Lv 50 builds mastery of your current job. Each step changes the light of your skills (no power change).
message.skyabyss.circuit.choose: Next task: head for either pillar. Gold gives two marks (harder), blue adds 2 minutes when cleared
gui.skyabyss.profile.title: Profile
gui.skyabyss.profile.see_journey: Fame per land and the codex in detail are on the Journey tab of the records screen
gui.skyabyss.profile.looks_note: Name tag colors and marks follow your rebirth tier (fixed)
circuit.skyabyss.task.break_go: Go to %s and break the foes' stake
circuit.skyabyss.task.break: Break the abyss stake (step out of its pulse ring)
item.skyabyss.fish_crucian.desc: The most common catch in the rivers around the capital, a dull gold-brown carp.
item.skyabyss.fish_sweetfish.desc: A slender river fish with a yellow spot behind the gills.
item.skyabyss.fish_bell_carp.desc: A moat carp whose golden scales line up like bells.
item.skyabyss.fish_mud_catfish.desc: A mud-colored catfish with a flat head and four long whiskers.
item.skyabyss.fish_striped_dace.desc: A small river fish with a black stripe down its middle.
item.skyabyss.fish_mill_trout.desc: A trout of mill streams, pink-banded with black spots.
item.skyabyss.fish_moss_sculpin.desc: A big-headed, spiny sculpin mottled like moss.
item.skyabyss.fish_songstone_flounder.de: A sandy flatfish with white rings like songstones.
item.skyabyss.fish_bone_cod.desc: A stout cod streaked with whalebone-white lines.
item.skyabyss.fish_barnacle_bream.desc: A grey-blue bream with barnacles on its back.
item.skyabyss.fish_ash_herring.desc: A slim herring that comes in shoals, dark-banded on the back.
item.skyabyss.fish_whalebone_eel.desc: A long eel striped like whale baleen. Rare.
item.skyabyss.fish_pearl_bream.desc: A pink bream with rows of pearl-like dots.
item.skyabyss.fish_tideshell_puffer.desc: A round puffer patterned with shell swirls.
item.skyabyss.fish_kelp_seahorse.desc: A seahorse trailing kelp-like fins. Rare.
item.skyabyss.fish_coral_parrotfish.desc: A teal fish edged in pink, with a beak-like mouth.
item.skyabyss.fish_moon_mackerel.desc: A long mackerel with moonlit wave lines on its back.
item.skyabyss.fish_swirl_shark.desc: A small shark with a white swirl on its belly. Rare.
item.skyabyss.fish_thunder_char.desc: A mountain char with a faintly glowing lightning pattern.
item.skyabyss.fish_cloud_trout.desc: A white trout with soft cloud-like blotches.
item.skyabyss.fish_pass_yamame.desc: A mountain-pass fish with oval parr marks.
item.skyabyss.fish_lightning_eel.desc: A glowing yellow eel with lightning along its body. Rare.
item.skyabyss.fish_featherfin_flyingfish: A flying fish that rides the wind on feather-like fins.
item.skyabyss.fish_glacier_icefish.desc: A slender, clear fish whose bones show through.
item.skyabyss.fish_ember_snapper.desc: A red snapper with embers glowing through cracks.
item.skyabyss.fish_ash_catfish.desc: An ash-dusted catfish banded with soot.
item.skyabyss.fish_hotspring_goldfish.de: A round hot-spring goldfish with a long, frilly tail.
item.skyabyss.fish_obsidian_spinefish.de: Obsidian-black with a purple sheen and sharp spines.
item.skyabyss.fish_firetail.desc: A fish whose tail flickers like a flame.
item.skyabyss.fish_flame_dragonfish.desc: A long, whiskered fish whose scales glow at the edges. Rare.
item.skyabyss.fish_dream_fish.desc: A very rare fish bearing a titan's ridge and stars on its body.
item.skyabyss.fishing_rod.desc: Cast at the water and pull when the float sinks. Each land has its own fish.
message.skyabyss.fishing.codex_done: The fish codex is complete! %s bell coins
message.skyabyss.fishing.prize: Last week's fishing contest: place %s! %s bell coins
message.skyabyss.fishing.head: Fish codex %s / %s  This week's fishing contest
message.skyabyss.fishing.board_foot: Points = size against the species' largest. At week's end the top three get %s, %s, %s bell coins
